title: Boone County Planning Commission — Checklists baseline reconciliation
scope: This reconciliation inventories every unique PDF linked under Documents/Applications Forms/Checklists/ on the preserved Boone County Planning Commission Applications and Forms page. Archived status means bounded source-identity evidence exists for that checklist. Live verified archive pending means a bounded live retrieval confirmed the exact official source is currently a PDF, but no byte-for-byte repository archive is claimed because the execution-layer download path was blocked; that execution failure is not evidence that the government source is unavailable. This inventory does not assert that any checklist applies to a particular sign project or that every instruction, requirement, fee, procedure, or approval path inside a listed checklist is current.
